name: display: flex
desc: Turns an element into a flex container. Its direct children become flex items on one axis.
body:
Only direct children become items. A grandchild keeps its own display type, so a nav inside a flex header needs `display: flex` of its own before its links behave as items.

Use `inline-flex` when the container should shrink to its content and sit inside a line of text.

name: flex-direction
desc: Sets the main axis of a flex container, which decides what justify-content and align-items act on.

name: flex-wrap
desc: Allows items to move to a new line when the main axis is full. The default nowrap shrinks items instead.
body: Wrapping creates lines. Each line is sized and aligned on its own, which is why `justify-content: space-between` leaves a lone item on the last line at the start. `align-content` only has an effect once there is more than one line.

name: justify-content
syntax: justify-content: flex-start | flex-end | center | space-between | space-around | space-evenly
desc: Distributes free space along the main axis. It does nothing when the items already fill that axis.
body:
The values are easy to mix up:

- `space-between` puts no space at the edges.
- `space-around` gives each item half a gap at the edges.
- `space-evenly` gives one equal gap everywhere, edges included.

With `flex-direction: column` this property controls vertical placement, and it needs a height or `min-height` on the container to have space to distribute.

name: align-items
syntax: align-items: stretch | flex-start | flex-end | center | baseline
desc: Aligns items on the cross axis inside their line. The default stretch makes items as tall as the line.

name: align-content
syntax: align-content: stretch | flex-start | center | space-between | space-around | space-evenly
desc: Distributes space between wrapped lines on the cross axis. It is ignored when the container has a single line.

name: gap
desc: Sets the space between flex or grid items. Two values mean row gap then column gap.

name: flex-grow
desc: A share of the container's free space, distributed in proportion to the value. Default 0 means no growth.

name: flex-shrink
desc: How much an item gives up when items overflow. Default 1 shrinks, 0 locks the size.

name: flex-basis
desc: The starting main size of an item before grow and shrink run. It wins over width on the main axis.

name: flex shorthand
syntax: flex: 1;  flex: auto;  flex: none;  flex: 2 1 200px;
desc: Sets grow, shrink and basis in one line. The one value form is the most common and the most misunderstood.
example:
.a { flex: 1; }      /* 1 1 0%   -> equal columns whatever the content */
.b { flex: auto; }   /* 1 1 auto -> content shaped columns */
.c { flex: none; }   /* 0 0 auto -> fixed by content */
.d { flex: 2 1 200px; } /* starts at 200px, takes double share */
body:
`flex: 1` sets the basis to zero, so three items split the container into equal thirds even when one label is much longer. `flex: auto` keeps the content width as the starting point, so the longer label keeps a wider column.

When a column looks wider than its siblings, check whether the shorthand was written as `flex: auto` somewhere.

name: order
desc: Changes paint order among flex or grid items. Lower numbers come first, ties keep source order.
body: Order changes the visual sequence only. Tab order and screen reader order stay in DOM order, so moving a link or a button with `order` produces a mismatch for keyboard users. Keep it for decoration, or reorder the markup instead.

name: align-self
syntax: align-self: auto | stretch | flex-start | flex-end | center | baseline;
desc: Overrides the container's align-items for a single item.

name: auto margin in flex
desc: An auto margin absorbs the free space on that side, pushing an item to the far end without a spacer element.

name: display: grid
desc: Turns an element into a grid container. Direct children become grid items placed in cells.

name: grid-template-columns
desc: Defines the column tracks: fixed lengths, fractions of free space, or a repeat pattern.

name: repeat()
desc: Repeats a track definition a fixed number of times, or as many times as fit when combined with auto-fill or auto-fit.
body: `repeat()` takes either a count or an auto keyword, never both: `repeat(3, 1fr)` and `repeat(auto-fit, 1fr)` are legal, `repeat(3, auto-fill)` is not. A `1fr` track is really `minmax(auto, 1fr)`, so long unbreakable content can widen it.

name: minmax()
desc: Gives a track a minimum and a maximum size. The common fix for both fixed floors and content overflow.

name: auto-fill and auto-fit
desc: auto-fill keeps empty tracks, auto-fit collapses them so the remaining items stretch to fill the row.

name: grid-template-rows
desc: Defines the explicit row tracks. Sizes rows, not items, and is often left to content.

name: grid-auto-rows
desc: Sizes rows the browser creates for items that do not fit the declared grid. Default auto means each row hugs its content.

name: grid-column and grid-row
desc: Places an item by line number or by a span. Negative lines count from the end of the grid.
body: The `/` form is start then end. In a four column grid the lines are 1 to 5, so `grid-column: 2 / 4` covers two columns. `-1` is the last line, which makes `1 / -1` the full row and saves you from updating numbers after a track change.

name: grid-template-areas
desc: Describes the layout as a visual map of area names, one quoted string per row. Items attach with grid-area.
body: Every string must describe the same number of columns. A repeated name makes an area span, and a dot marks an empty cell. Each area must form a rectangle; an L shape makes the whole declaration invalid, so the layout silently falls back to auto placement.

name: grid-area
desc: Attaches an item to a named area, or places it with four line values in row start, column start, row end, column end order.

name: place-items
desc: Shorthand for align-items and justify-items, which align items inside their cells. The shortest way to centre one child.

name: grid-auto-flow
desc: Controls how auto placed items fill the grid. dense backfills holes left by spanning items.

name: responsive card gallery
desc: A card row that reflows by available width, with no media query. The track count changes as the container changes.
